text: Shenyang Pharmaceutical University (SPU) is a comprehensive pharmaceutical university in China with a historyof more than 90 vears, it was founded in 1931, so it has the longest history with pharmaceutical science in ChinaThere are three campuses, located in Shenyang and Benxi separately. At present, there are over 26,226students in total, including 5214 graduates, of them, 652 doctoral students and 4562 master students, 9900undergraduate students, and 11 1 12 students for adult continuing education. There are 1 167 staff, including 156professors and 260 associate professors.The total area of SPU is about 1,330,200 square meters, and the totaconstruction areais about 664.500 square meters.At present, SPU has developed into a multi-disciplinary, multi-level and multi-form educational university othigher pharmacy. There are 11 schools in SPu, which are School of Pharmacy, School of PharmaceuticalEngineering, School of Traditional Chinese Medicine, School of Life Science and Biopharmaceutical ScienceSchool of Functional Food and Wine, $chool of Medical Devices, $chool of Wuya lnnovation, $chool of BusinessAdministration,School of Continuing Education, School of Marxism .SPU is open to the world. lt has established long-term and stable cooperative relations with 73 colleges anduniversities and scientific research institutions in 20 countries and regions such as the United States, the UnitedKingdom, Denmark, Russia, japan and Portugal, SPU warmly welcomes students from all over the world to studyhere.
